notes: BATTLE PASS · Season 1: AFTERSHOCK - 100 tiers. Free row: DZ, free chance boxes and cosmetics. Premium row: a pass-only cosmetic every tier (free during the beta)
NEW: gun CHARMS that hang off your gun and swing as you move, and account BANNERS behind your name (lobby and the death cam). Both come from chance boxes and the battle pass
LOCKER: tabs for Camos, Stickers and Charms on each gun, a Banners page, faster weapon pictures, the list no longer jumps to the top
SCORESTREAKS: cost more (UAV 550 to Airstrike 1700), 15 s between call-ins and a cooldown before each can be earned again, streak kills don't earn streaks, strikes hit a little softer
HUD: simpler, solid colours with an outline so every number and message is readable
RECOIL: every gun kicks harder and climbs more on a spray (assault rifles and SMGs most); less of it recovers on its own
